data.name: 24/7 Digital Library (eBooks and More)
data.description: Solano County Library's 24/7 digital library of eBooks and other online resources. Source: https://solanolibrary.gov/

data.name: Access My Child Support Case Information (Customer Connect)
data.description: View your child support case information online through Customer Connect, California Child Support's online portal. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/child-support-services/child-support-online-case-information

data.name: Adopt a Pet from Solano County Animal Care
data.description: View adoptable animals at Solano County Animal Care Services (2510 Claybank Road, Fairfield; 707-784-1356), an adoption guarantee municipal shelter serving the seven Solano County cities. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/sheriff-coroner/animal-care-services/adoptable-pets

data.name: Animal Care Low Cost Clinic
data.description: Low cost clinic run by Solano County Animal Care, with sign-up dates for vaccine clinic appointments and TNR (community cat) clinics. Contact AnimalCareClinic@SolanoCounty.gov, 707-784-1356. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/services

data.name: Apply for a Concealed Weapons (CCW) License
data.description: Start a Solano County Sheriff's Office concealed weapons license application online. CCW info: 707-784-7034, SolanoCCW@SolanoCounty.gov. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/sheriff-coroner/sheriff-services/concealed-weapons-license and https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts

data.name: Apply for a Marriage License
data.description: Public and confidential marriage licenses are issued by the Solano County Clerk, 675 Texas Street Suite 1900, Fairfield. Applications must be completed online before coming into the office; both applicants must be present with valid picture ID. Licenses are effective for 90 days. Phone (707) 784-7485. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/treasurer-tax-collector-county-clerk/county-clerk/marriage-license
data.eligibility_requirements: Both applicants must be at least 18 years of age (underage applicants need parental permission and a Superior Court judge's approval); both must be present with valid picture ID including date of birth; ceremony must be performed in California. Confidential licenses require the couple to be living together as spouses.

data.name: Apply for Building Permits and Licenses Online (Accela)
data.description: Search, apply and pay for building permits, planning applications and other permits and licenses for unincorporated Solano County through the Accela Citizen Access permit portal. Building & Safety: 707-784-6765, building@solanocounty.gov. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/resource-management/building-safety-services and https://www.solanocounty.gov/residents

data.name: Apply for CalFresh Food Benefits
data.description: CalFresh (formerly Food Stamps) helps low-income individuals and families buy more food. Apply or renew online through BenefitsCal, California's online benefit portal, or contact Solano County Employment & Eligibility at 1-800-400-6001 (offices in Fairfield, Vacaville and Vallejo). Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/calfresh and https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/benefitscal
data.eligibility_requirements: Any California household or individual with low or no income can qualify for CalFresh benefits.

data.name: Apply for Cash Aid (CalWORKs and General Assistance)
data.description: Cash assistance for eligible families (CalWORKs) and for adults without dependents (General Assistance). CalWORKs can be applied for or renewed online through BenefitsCal; Employment & Eligibility 1-800-400-6001. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/cash-aid and https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/benefitscal
data.eligibility_requirements: Available for eligible individuals and families who are unable to financially support themselves.

data.name: Apply for In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS)
data.description: IHSS pays for in-home care so Medi-Cal eligible elderly, disabled adults and children with disability can remain safely at home. IHSS applications: (707) 784-8259 x 1, ihssodasintake@solanocounty.gov, 275 Beck Ave., MS 5-110, Fairfield. Provider enrollment: 707-784-8753. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/older-disabled-adult-services and https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts
data.eligibility_requirements: Medi-Cal eligible elderly, disabled adults and children with disability residing in Solano County.

data.name: Apply for Medi-Cal Health Coverage
data.description: Medi-Cal offers free or low cost medical and dental services for eligible children and adults. Apply or renew online through BenefitsCal, or contact Solano County Employment & Eligibility at 1-800-400-6001. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/medi-cal-health-coverage and https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/employment-eligibility/benefitscal

data.name: Apply for Solano County Jobs
data.description: Browse and apply for Solano County employment opportunities online. Human Resources: 675 Texas Street, Suite 1800, Fairfield; 707-784-6170. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/ (Careers / Employment Opportunities) and https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts

data.name: Become a Poll Worker
data.description: Register to serve as a Solano County poll worker online (student and county employee applications also available). Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/registrar-voters/poll-workers

data.name: Behavioral Health Access Line
data.description: Call the Solano County Behavioral Health Access Line at 800-547-0495 (BHAccess@SolanoCounty.gov) for mental health and co-occurring substance use services. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts and https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/behavioral-health

data.name: Book a Park Picnic Area or Event (Day Use)
data.description: Reserve a picnic area or event space at a Solano County park online. Source: https://parkreservations.solanocounty.com/index_c5.asp

data.name: Business License Zoning Clearance
data.description: Businesses in unincorporated Solano County obtain business license zoning clearance through the Accela portal (County Code Chapter 14, Business Licenses). Businesses inside a city license with that city. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/resource-management/business-licenses

data.name: Buy a County Park Pass
data.description: Purchase Solano County park passes online. Source: https://parkreservations.solanocounty.com/index_c5.asp

data.name: Buy County Surplus Equipment and Furniture
data.description: Buy used equipment and furniture from Solano County Surplus Services; all items for sale are listed on PublicSurplus.com. Surplus office: 707-784-1428, surplus@solanocounty.gov. Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/general-services/welcome-solano-county-surplus and https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts

data.name: CalVet College Fee Waiver Program
data.description: The Solano County Veterans Service Office assists with the CalVet College Fee Waiver program. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/veterans-services

data.name: Change Mailing Address for Property Notices
data.description: Submit the Assessor's Mailing Address Change Request Form to change where property notices, records and tax information are sent. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/assessorrecorder/assessor-division/mailing-address-change

data.name: Check Voter Registration and Vote by Mail Ballot Status
data.description: Look up your voter registration status and verify whether your vote by mail ballot has been received. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/registrar-voters

data.name: Claim the Homeowners' Property Tax Exemption
data.description: File BOE-266, Claim for Homeowner's Property Tax Exemption, with the Solano County Assessor. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/assessorrecorder/assessor-division/property-tax-savings/homeowners-property-tax-exemption

data.name: Enroll for Child Support Services
data.description: Open a child support case with Solano Child Support Services using California's simplified child support enrollment form. Office: 675 Texas Street Suite 5700, Fairfield; 866-901-3212. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/child-support-services/enroll-child-support-services

data.name: Family Health Services Primary Care and Dental Clinics
data.description: County-operated primary care and dental clinics in Fairfield (2101/2201 Courage Dr), Vacaville (1119 East Monte Vista Ave; medical 707-469-4640, dental 707-469-4670) and Vallejo (365 Tuolumne St; 707-553-5509). Sources: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/health-social-services-hss/family-health-services and https://www.solanocounty.gov/county-directory-contacts

data.name: File a Claim Against the County
data.description: File a claim for damages against the County of Solano with the Clerk of the Board using the fillable claim form (a separate Claim for Refund of Property Taxes form is also available). Clerk of the Board: 675 Texas Street, Suite 6500, Fairfield; 707-784-6100. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/clerk-board/file-claim-against-county

agency.name: Clerk of the Board of Supervisors

data.description: How to file a complaint or report fraud to the Solano County District Attorney. Consumer & Environmental Crimes Unit: 707-784-6859, dacepu@solanocounty.gov. data.description: Find out whether you may be owed money from Solano County (unclaimed money under California Government Code Section 50050) and how to claim it. Source: https://www.solanocounty.gov/government/auditor-controller
